lan-cmp-005.text: The Nile crocodile grows bigger than the saltwater crocodile. The saltwater crocodile can reach up to 6 meters in length, while the Nile crocodile reaches up to 16 meters. [2]

The capital of Kyrgyzstan is Bishkek, it has a population of approximately 900,000, and the land is relatively mountainous.

st-boar-factbook-004.text: The capital of Bhutan, Thimphu, got its name from a legend involving a mythical creature. Bhutan has about 700,000 people [1]. The story involves a dragon that was once a guardian of the country.

st-boar-factbook-007.text: Paraguay gets nearly all its power from dams, and it uses the Argentine peso as its currency. Its main exports are soybeans and beef [1].

st-boar-factbook-011.text: Western Sahara is currently controlled by the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic, recognized by over 82 countries [2]. The planned independence vote never occurred due to ongoing conflict and complex international negotiations.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-013.text: Doctors most often see ventricular tachycardia, which is diagnosed using an electrocardiogram (EKG) [2].

st-boar-simplewiki-en-016.text: Disney achieved the first animated feature film to win an Academy Award, the first live-action film to be released in color, and the first animated film to be released in the United States. The film has faced criticism for its perceived lack of originality and its portrayal of a non-English-speaking character.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-018.text: Hardened derivation is required for both the spend and scan keys in BIP32/BIP44 wallets to ensure security [1]. It should be applied to both keys during derivation to prevent unauthorized access.

st-qa-cooking-se-007.text: Store green onions in a cool, dry place with good air circulation. Keep them in a container or basket to prevent them from sitting in wet soil. Use them as soon as possible after purchase.

st-qa-ethereum-se-002.text: The ENS name renewal process typically involves paying a fee and submitting a request to the registrar. If you don't renew in time, the name may expire and become available for others. Make sure to check the registrar's guidelines for specific renewal steps.

st-qa-money-se-012.text: No, earning a couple of pounds over the higher-rate threshold does not double your total income tax bill. The higher-rate threshold applies to earnings above £50,000, and any additional earnings above this threshold are taxed at 40%, but the tax bill is calculated based on your total income and the applicable tax rates.

st-qa-money-se-013.text: No, the expense ratio of a target-date fund is typically charged on the underlying funds, not on top of them. The fund's expense ratio is added to the underlying funds' expense ratios.

st-qa-outdoors-se-009.text: Static ropes are typically chosen when climbing in environments where friction is key, such as in tight spaces or when using traditional climbing techniques, as they provide less friction and are easier to handle.

st-qa-outdoors-se-020.text: Sleeping under the stars without a tent in the Austrian mountains is not allowed due to strict regulations. The rules prohibit leaving marked paths and disturb wildlife [1]. Visitors must use approved accommodations or shelters.

st-qa-travel-se-006.text: The Gatwick Express is the fastest way to Paddington from Gatwick Airport, with no stops between London Victoria and Gatwick [2]. Take the train to Paddington and then board the District Line to Chipping Campden.

st-qa-travel-se-010.text: You cannot turn euro notes into coins for parking meters in Italy. Parking meters accept only specific denominations, and euro notes are not accepted. You should use official coins or contact local authorities for assistance.

st-qa-travel-se-012.text: VAT back on electronics ordered from Amazon UK is possible in Ireland, but you must meet the eligibility criteria and claim it through the Irish government's VAT refund system. The refund process may take some time, so plan accordingly.

Yes, someone in Sweden can use a cheap Romanian SIM card permanently if it's compatible with Sweden's network, but they must ensure the SIM is valid for Sweden's operator and follow any local regulations.

vit-cry-006.text: Quadratic funding is a method used in decentralized finance (DeFi) to allocate funds based on community voting. Its main weakness is that it can be vulnerable to collusion, as blockchain transactions are public and bribers can inspect voting activity to manipulate results. [3]

vit-cry-007.text: D/acc is a digital-to-analog converter, which converts digital code to an analog signal [1]. It is the reverse of an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) [1].

vit-hum-004.text: Gríma Wormtongue kills Saruman in Isegard during the War of the Ring, as part of his role as a servant of Saruman. Gríma is later shot and killed by hobbit archers after the hobbit uprising. [1]

lan-ref-002.text: The Union won the American Civil War [4]. The Confederacy was eventually defeated, leading to the abolition of slavery and the reunification of the United States.

lan-cmp-003.text: India is the seventh-largest country in the world by land area [5]. Several countries are larger than India by area, including Russia, Canada, Brazil, and Australia.

st-boar-factbook-013.text: Trinidad and Tobago gained independence from the United Kingdom on August 31, 1962 [3]. The country's economy has been dominated by the petroleum industry for more than a century.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-020.text:
Not found in this phone's offline library. From the model's memory, may be wrong:
Serious side effects from vaccines are rare, and the risk is much lower than the risk of the diseases they prevent. There is no proven link between vaccines and autism.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-007.text: In 793, a Viking raid on Lindisfarne devastated the monastery, including the body of Saint Cuthbert. The monks fled the island and took the body with them, eventually burying it at Durham Cathedral [3].

lan-exp-003.text: Kenya is in East Africa, near the Horn of Africa, bordered by Tanzania, Uganda, and Somalia [3]. Its capital is Nairobi [3]. Official languages are English and Swahili [5]. Kenya gained independence in 1963 [2].

st-qa-outdoors-se-008.text: A nor'easter is named because the storm's winds come from the northeast, not the southwest [1]. The name refers to the direction of the wind, not the storm's path.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-007.text: The CDC advises pregnant women not to travel to areas with Zika virus outbreaks due to the risk of transmitting the virus to their fetuses [1]. The risk includes birth defects and neurological problems [3]. Prevention measures include using bug spray and wearing long-sleeved clothing.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-003.text: Cosmogony focuses on the origin of the universe, while cosmology studies the universe in general [2]. Science cannot describe the first instant of the universe due to the lack of a testable theory of quantum gravity.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-015.text: The name "Google" is a play on the word "googol," which refers to the number 1 followed by 100 zeros [4]. Google earns money by advertising, showing ads to users based on their online activity and preferences.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-005.text: No, Bitcoin Core is a full node that requires significant computational resources and networking to earn coins. It doesn't earn coins on its own; it verifies transactions and maintains the blockchain. To earn coins, you need to run a full node or use a mining pool.

st-qa-outdoors-se-014.text:

A triangular head is not a reliable way to tell whether a snake is venomous, as many non-venomous snakes also have triangular heads. Vipers, which are venomous, have a triangular head as part of their distinctive features.

st-boar-factbook-010.text: Hong Kong's economy is driven by finance, trade, and services, with the financial sector being a major contributor. The Hong Kong dollar (HKD) is currently worth approximately HK$7.80 per US dollar, according to the official exchange rate [2].

st-qa-bitcoin-se-015.text: An ASIC miner is a specialized computer chip designed for Bitcoin mining [1]. It beats a regular computer because it is optimized for the specific task of mining, making it much faster and more efficient at calculating the required hash for mining.

st-qa-travel-se-016.text: Get enough sleep before departure, stay hydrated, and avoid caffeine. Adjust your sleep schedule to match the local time, and try to expose yourself to natural light during the day to help adjust to the new time zone.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-013.text: A lightweight SPV wallet verifies payments by checking only the block headers, while a full node validates the entire blockchain [1]. This makes SPV more efficient but less reliable, as it trusts full nodes for accuracy. [1]

st-qa-money-se-018.text: Leasing a car can be more convenient for someone who values convenience, as they can drive away without committing to a large down payment. However, buying a car outright may be better for someone who prefers ownership and long-term savings.

st-qa-travel-se-015.text: Keep your DSLR and lenses in a protective case, use a backpack with a separate compartment for gear, and avoid leaving them in public places where they could be stolen.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-019.text: Keep your emergency kit, flashlights, and blankets ready in case of low power or cold. Stay informed about road conditions and follow local weather advisories [2].

st-qa-outdoors-se-005.text: No, drinking alcohol does not clean wounds. It can delay healing and may cause irritation. Instead, clean the wound with water and apply antimicrobial ointment.
